body:
You're basically looking for the file configuring the autocomplete. (My guess would be that there should be something like `autocomplete.js`)
In this file, there will be the main call to the library:

```js
autocomplete('xxx', { hint: false }, ...)
```

You'll need to add the `debug` and `appendTo` parameter to it, like so:

```js
autocomplete('xxx', {
  hint: false,
  debug: true,
  appendTo: '.waikiki-search > .search-content'
}, ...)
```
